faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers regarding freight pricing, customs clearance, restricted commodities, and transit times.
faq.q1: How are freight shipping rates and chargeable weights calculated?
faq.a1: Freight charges depend on whichever is greater: actual gross weight or volumetric (dimensional) weight. For air freight, the volumetric formula is (Length × Width × Height in cm) / 6000. For ocean LCL, rates are billed per CBM (cubic meter) or 1,000 kg. For overland GCC trucking, standard full truckload (FTL) rates apply or CBM-based LTL pricing.
faq.q2: What commodities are restricted, prohibited, or subject to special permits?
faq.a2: Prohibited items include narcotics, unapproved pharmaceuticals, weapons, fireworks, and counterfeit goods. Regulated items requiring pre-approval include lithium batteries (requiring UN 38.3 test summaries & MSDS), chemicals/dangerous goods (requiring IATA/IMDG declarations), food and cosmetics (requiring SFDA pre-registration), and electronics/machinery (requiring SABER PCoC/SCoC).
faq.q3: What documentation is required for import customs clearance in Saudi Arabia?
faq.a3: Standard import documentation includes: 1) Original Commercial Invoice with HS codes; 2) Detailed Packing List; 3) Clean Bill of Lading (B/L) or Air Waybill (AWB); 4) Attested Certificate of Origin; 5) SABER Shipment Certificate of Conformity (SCoC); and 6) SFDA import permit for food, medical, or cosmetics. Our licensed FASAH brokers can handle the full clearance workflow.
faq.q4: What are your typical transit times across Air, Ocean, and Land freight?
faq.a4: Typical transit times: Air Freight: 1–3 business days for Express, 3–5 days for Standard. Overland GCC Trucking: 12–24 hours domestic intercity, 2–4 days cross-border. Ocean Freight: 14–22 days on Asia–Arabian Gulf routes, 18–28 days Europe–Middle East, and 28–38 days Americas–Middle East.
faq.q5: Can I track my shipment online, and how do I receive live status updates?
faq.a5: Yes! You can enter your tracking reference (such as GLS-882914 or your Bill of Lading / AWB number) in the Live Shipment Tracker at the top of our homepage. We also provide automated SMS, WhatsApp, and email milestone notifications at each stage of transit.
faq.q6: How fast can I get a quotation, and how do I set up a corporate credit account?
faq.a6: Click 'Get a Quote' anywhere on the site or email sales@global-logisticssolution.com. We respond within 24 hours. For regular commercial shippers, our accounts department (accounts@global-logisticssolution.com) offers 30-day corporate credit facilities upon credit verification.

navigating-red-sea-reroutes.excerpt: How shippers are balancing transit time and cost when ocean lanes shift.
navigating-red-sea-reroutes.author: Global Logistics Solutions Operations
navigating-red-sea-reroutes.body:
Ocean carriers continue to adjust schedules across the Suez corridor. Global Logistics Solutions monitors sailings daily and advises clients on alternate hubs and air-sea combinations when deadlines are tight.

Key steps: confirm booking cut-offs early, allow buffer at transshipment ports, and align customs documentation before cargo arrives.
